title: Natural native open sheaf tensor comparisons
statement: The normalized pointwise restriction maps of a native open tensor datum assemble into a natural isomorphism between native sheaf tensor followed by restriction and componentwise restriction followed by sheaf tensor. There is also a natural sheaf open projection isomorphism.

source.place: lemma-pullback-tensor-product; lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; totalization of the sheaf comparisons

proof.text: The prescribed underlying restriction map is natural in its first factor by naturality of adicUpperStarTensorLeftIso, and in its second factor by the module tensorLeftMap comparison. The inverse-mates formula identifies nativeTensorMap with the ordinary tensor map after faithful forgetting. Hence the normalized pointwise restriction maps assemble to a natural isomorphism. Prove the lifting calculation first for an arbitrary Frobenius transport isomorphism, then specialize through the defining equation for native upperStar; this avoids expanding the concrete transport while checking naturality.
Obtain the natural sheaf projection isomorphism from the native sheaf projection theorem using the adjunction and normalization fields of s.

theorem native_open_tensor_sheaf_comparisons (s : NativeOpenTensorData k₀ l j) :
    Nonempty (nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l Z ⋙ upperStar k₀ l j ≅
      (upperStar k₀ l j).prod (upperStar k₀ l j) ⋙ nativeOpenSheafTensor k₀ l U) ∧
      Nonempty (nativeOpenSheafLeft k₀ l j ≅ nativeOpenSheafRight k₀ l j)
